insured.label: Insured
insured.description: < 20% down payment, default-insured via CMHC / Sagen / Canada Guaranty
insured.note: Best rates available — insurance premium (2.8–4.0%) added to mortgage balance

insurable.label: Insurable
insurable.description: ≥ 20% down, purchase ≤ $1M, qualifies for lender-paid bulk portfolio insurance
insurable.note: Near-insured pricing without the borrower-paid premium

uninsured.label: Uninsured
uninsured.note: Highest rates but most flexibility — 30yr amort available

lenders.name: TD Bank
lenders.penalty_note: Worst penalties in Canada — uses inflated posted rate for IRD calculation
lenders.flow_advantage: Our monoline lenders use fair discount-rate IRD. On a $400K mortgage breaking 2yr early: TD penalty ~$12,000 vs monoline ~$3,500.

lenders.name: RBC
lenders.penalty_note: Uses posted rate for IRD — similar to TD in penalty severity
lenders.flow_advantage: RBC's 'special offer' rates still trail broker-channel pricing by 0.3–0.5%. Plus their penalties are 2–3x higher.

lenders.name: Scotiabank
lenders.penalty_note: eHOME rates have restrictive prepayment terms — read the fine print
lenders.flow_advantage: Scotia's eHOME 'low rate' product restricts prepayments to 15% and has bona fide sale clause. Our lenders offer 20% prepayment + portable.

lenders.name: BMO
lenders.penalty_note: Fairest Big 5 penalty — uses discounted rate for IRD (still higher than monolines)
lenders.flow_advantage: BMO has the fairest Big 5 penalties, but their rates are still 0.2–0.4% above broker channel. We match BMO's penalty fairness with better rates.

lenders.name: CIBC
lenders.flow_advantage: CIBC's mortgage specialists are limited to CIBC products. We access 30+ lenders to find the absolute best fit.

lenders.name: First National
lenders.penalty_note: Canada's largest non-bank lender — fair penalties, excellent service
lenders.flow_advantage: First National is our go-to for rate + flexibility. Discount-rate IRD, 20% annual prepayment, fully portable.

lenders.name: MCAP
lenders.penalty_note: Competitive rates, strong broker channel presence
lenders.flow_advantage: MCAP often leads on insured pricing. Fair penalties + strong online portal for clients.

lenders.name: RMG
lenders.penalty_note: Part of MCAP family — similar terms and flexibility
lenders.flow_advantage: RMG offers aggressive variable-rate pricing. Great for clients who want flexibility + fair penalty terms.

lenders.name: CMLS
lenders.penalty_note: Solid uninsured product — competitive on longer terms
lenders.flow_advantage: CMLS excels on 3-year and longer fixed terms for uninsured. Their 30yr amort pricing is among the best.

lenders.name: Manulife
lenders.penalty_note: Manulife One (all-in-one) product available for flexible borrowers
lenders.flow_advantage: Manulife One is the best all-in-one account in Canada — mortgage + chequing + savings. Ideal for self-employed and investors.

flow_value_props.title: Penalty Savings
flow_value_props.hook: Big 5 banks use posted-rate IRD = massive penalties. Our monoline lenders use discount-rate IRD — saving you thousands if you break early.
flow_value_props.proof: $400K mortgage, breaking 2yr early: TD penalty ~$12,000 vs. First National ~$3,500

flow_value_props.title: 30+ Lenders, One Application
flow_value_props.hook: We shop 30+ lenders instantly. Your bank only shows you their own products — and their 'best rate' still trails broker pricing by 0.3–0.5%.
flow_value_props.proof: Average Flow client saves $4,200/yr vs. their bank's renewal offer

flow_value_props.title: 30-Year Amortization
flow_value_props.hook: Uninsured mortgages qualify for 30yr amortization — lower payments and more monthly cash flow for investments or life.

flow_value_props.title: $0 Cost Switch at Renewal
flow_value_props.hook: At renewal, switching lenders through a broker costs $0 in most cases. Your bank just won't tell you that.
flow_value_props.proof: 95% of Canadians auto-renew and overpay by 0.5–1.5% — that's $2,500–$7,500/yr on $500K
